event: Shut down from midday on 31 October 2022. To be converted to 150 MW of solar 70 MW of wind and 150 MW of batteries; no gas plant
source: Capacity: Eskom fact sheet GX 0001 Rev 29. Shutdown: Eskom statement of 31 October 2022 (eskom.co.za)
note: Only one unit of 121 MW was still running at shutdown. Eskom's July 2024 fact sheet still lists the station

event: Exemption to operate until 31 March 2030. Eskom was to decide by end September 2026 between shutdown repowering and repurposing. No decision had been announced by 8 October 2026: Eskom's media statements to 7 October carry none and on 3 September its chief executive said only that shutdown repowering and repurposing 'must be informed by evidence'
source: Capacity: Eskom fact sheet GX 0001 Rev 29. Dates: TechCentral 22 April 2026. Decision status: Eskom media statements page and Sunday Times 3 September 2026
